themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: The New York Times reported Saturday Nov 21 that the SEC inquiry into Nvidia covers its accounting practices and is at an early stage; it could end with no charges (AFP). It may tie to Nvidia's switch to reporting sales by customer headquarters instead of billing location, which removed Singapore from its regional breakdown; Singapore had been 22% of revenue in the quarter ended July 2025 (Fortune). The probe itself was first reported by the Wall Street Journal on Nov 17, not on Nov 20 as the last entry implied (InvestmentNews).
themes.for_you: An accounting question tends to keep buyers away until it is settled. NVDA is not on the long term scan buy list; no NVDA puts while the group falls. Next dates: about Nov 27 for the board's answers to Treasury, and Dec 1 for Huang's House interview.
